label: The token ' quite' (lowercase, leading space) when the nearest preceding content word is a lexical verb or the verb's object noun/pronoun; near-zero when a finite copula (is/was/are) or 'not' stands within two tokens before it, and for degree synonyms (rather, fairly, very) in the same slot.

probed_before.source: this checkout's .probe-log, before the pre-registration commit

notes: Card: 30/32 top peaks are ' quite' (max 3.69; 28 tokens >0.3*max, all +g -u; 97% leak mass (-g +u) below 0.3). Probes: verb/object + ' quite' fired - 'defense quite considerably' 0.72, 'rose quite rapidly' 0.53 - but 'had to replace quite a few' only 0.12 (cause unknown; ' quite' at 0-based 5/6/9 gave 0.12/0.53/0.72). Copula killed it: 'was quite' 0.016, 'are quite' 0.023, 'was not quite' 0.018, 'was, quite frankly' 0.017 (peaks moved off ' quite'), though corpus 'that, quite frankly' is 0.69, so the copula suppresses across one token. The only 'not' probe also had ' was' two tokens back, so 'not' alone is untested until near miss 3; have/be auxiliaries do not suppress ('had jumped quite' 0.68, 'can be accomplished quite' 0.76): the established suppressor is a finite is/was/are within two tokens. Token identity needed: ' rather'/' fairly'/' pretty'/' very' in slot 0.011-0.018 (= floor 0.018-0.019); ' quiet' 0.029; no-space 'quite' 0.018/0.042; ' Quite' 0.015. Verdict: H2 context-gated ' quite'; H1 refuted by copulas, H3 by synonyms. Fires: lexical verb or direct object directly before ' quite' (preceding words all single tokens), ' quite' at 0-based 8-15, no copula or 'not'. Near misses: 2 copula + ' quite', 1 'had not quite', 3 synonyms in slot, verb + ' quiet', '(quite' (' (' + 'quite'). + pole: ' or' echo detector, unrelated. Tiny max so 0.20 (0.74 raw) is not automatic; 0.12 probe = unexplained variance.
